uncertainty.per_run: worst-case interval from the reporting resolution of each value
uncertainty.summary: median with percentile bootstrap 95% CI (9999 resamples, seed 20261114)

limitations: Diagnostic of internal consistency, not a validation of the d^2-law or of NASA values.
K is the FLEX team's fit from shortly after ignition to extinction (excludes heat-up); D0 is at igniter-on; the definition of the tabulated burn time is not documented here, so r = 1 is not expected.
Reported Dext may be extrapolated in some runs (noted in report captions, unregistered source).
Flags mark runs for review; no value is corrected or removed from the source.

oxygen_effect.model: K = b0 + b1 * X_O2 ; sensitivity: K = b0 + b1 * X_O2 + b2 * D0 ; OLS, HC3 standard errors, Student-t 95% CI
oxygen_effect.value_origin: reported K (FLEX team) and reported conditions (PSI-69); coefficients derived here

limitations: Association within strata, not a causal effect: runs were not randomised and D0 and other conditions vary (D0-adjusted model given as a sensitivity check).
Support mode comes from NASA/TP-2015-216046 figure captions (unregistered source, pypdf text not visually verified); used only to avoid pooling support modes.
Linear form is a local approximation over the observed O2 range; no extrapolation.
Strata are small; HC3 intervals are wide and p-values are not corrected for multiple strata.
